queries.a: MATCH (n:ProbeNode) WHERE coalesce(n.id,null)=1 RETURN n.uid AS uid

recipe.equivalence: COALESCE(property,NULL) preserves the property value. The state uses integer id properties and both queries select id=1.
recipe.work_obligation: Simplify the redundant COALESCE wrapper so the existing property index can be used, as the same property-map predicate does.
recipe.novelty: Separate no-op wrapper probe; do not assume it is the same root cause as the previously reported direct-WHERE issue.
